summary: Improve accessible recruitment, workplace adjustments, and HR reporting with practical tools. Explore the five-day course and its curriculum.
lede: Disability inclusion training for HR teams covers ways to make recruitment, employee development, and workplace processes more accessible. It is designed for HR practitioners who shape hiring and learning processes, respond to workplace adjustment requests, or monitor accessibility across the employee lifecycle. Participants practise reviewing recruitment content, mapping adjustment workflows, checking digital HR materials, and assessing accessibility risks in AI-assisted screening.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape disability inclusion in HR processes, make workplace adjustments, or monitor accessibility across the employee lifecycle.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of HR processes such as recruitment, employee relations, or learning and development is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Word, Excel, and PowerPoint if available; the course uses document and spreadsheet exercises that can also be completed with equivalent accessible office tools.
